channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from summarizedStoriesMainNLhealthAndWellness, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Gene therapy provides lasting benefit in Wiskott-Aldrich syndrome
item.description: An analysis of data from over two dozen patients with Wiskott-Aldrich syndrome found that treatment with etuvetidigene autotemcel was associated with sustained benefits.

item.title: Anitocabtagene autoleucel linked to sustained response in pretreated multiple myeloma
item.description: In a phase 1 trial of patients with triple-class refractory multiple myeloma, anitocabtagene autoleucel produced a complete response.

item.title: 2 Minute Medicine Rewind September 28, 2026
item.description: Probiotics and Risk of Death, Necrotizing Enterocolitis, and Sepsis in Very Preterm Infants: Probiotic supplementation was associated with a lower risk.

item.title: Raw milk cheese recalled nationwide after E. coli outbreak sickens 13
item.description: All Graziers raw milk cheeses are being recalled nationwide after being linked to an E. coli outbreak that has sickened more than a dozen people.
